- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is $2.97 billion with a gross margin of 46.7% and an EBITDA margin of 17.4%.
- The company that contributes most to the revenue is Wipro Consumer Care India with $2.97 billion, and the one that needs attention is not explicitly stated but since Wipro Consumer Care India is the only company listed, it implies that this is the segment to focus on for improvement.
- Margins are at 46.7% for gross margin and 17.4% for EBITDA margin, indicating a significant portion of revenue is retained as gross profit but a smaller fraction translates to EBITDA.
- Working capital as of 2024-12-01 is influenced by 51 days of DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) and 75 days of DPO (Days Payable Outstanding), indicating a net working capital requirement due to the longer payment period to suppliers compared to the collection period from customers.
- The top 3 revenue drivers are profit centre 20 with a $0.05 billion change (66.7% of total change), everything excluding profit centre 20 with a $0.03 billion change (33.3% of total change), and profit centre 30 with a $0.04 billion change (45.7% of total change), though the ranking of the last two may be inconsistent based on the provided share of total change percentages.
